title: Microbundle inference surface PRD and deployment checklist
creator: Aisha Park
description: Goal: deliver a compact, opinionated hosted API 'microbundle' that exposes chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank as a single product surface optimized for low operational friction and predictable economics. This PRD defines required behavior, non-goals, success metrics, acceptance tests, and a deployment checklist for a staged launch (canary -> region rollout -> general availability).
background: Customers frequently ask for a minimal, consistent hosted surface that includes the four most-used inference primitives: chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank. Existing hosted endpoint variants and modular endpoints create fragmentation in docs, billing, and SDKs. The microbundle bundles these four primitives into a single, documented product SKU with shared routing, adaptive model selection, and a single price band option for fast adoption by PLG teams. This initiative reduces cognitive overhead for integrators and simplifies rollout of shared runtime improvements (caching, kernel selection).
goals: Provide one unified hosted API surface that supports chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank with consistent authentication, throttling, and telemetry
Ensure production-grade performance: defined latency SLOs across short/long sequences and stable P95 under target concurrency
Ship SDK examples and migration guide so existing users can adopt microbundle without code rewrites
Enable staged rollout with automated canary checks and an operator-facing rollback path
Deliver price transparency and per-route cost/latency telemetry in Console for the new SKU
non_goals: Not a migration tool that force-converts all existing hosted endpoints automatically
Not introducing new model families — microbundle will use existing curated models only
Not modifying private or Dedicated deployment flows for this launch (Private integration will be a follow-up)
api_endpoints: POST /v1/microbundle/chat - streaming and non-streaming chat with function/tool calling support
POST /v1/microbundle/completions - single-turn completions compatible with existing params (max_tokens, temperature, stop)
POST /v1/microbundle/embeddings - batched embedding generation with per-request vs bulk options
POST /v1/microbundle/rerank - reranking primitive that accepts candidates + query and returns scores + optionally rewrites
requirements: Single API key and quota bucket for microbundle SKU (no per-endpoint key changes)
Consistent error schema and status codes across primitives
Streaming behavior must mirror existing chat/stream semantics in our SDKs
Telemetry includes per-request token counts, model_variant, runtime_duration_ms, and cache_hit boolean
Adaptive model selection: default model chosen by cost/latency policy, configurable per-tenant via Console
Graceful fallback to smaller model variant when primary variant is unavailable
Prefix caching for repeated prompts across chat/completions to reduce token cost
Embeddings endpoint supports up to 1024 inputs per batch (subject to runtime limits) with automatic chunking
Rerank returns stable, explainable scores and supports both 'score-only' and 'score+rewrite' modes
API surface compatibility: users of existing chat/completions endpoints can call microbundle with minimal param translation (migration guide provided)
acceptance_criteria: Functional: each endpoint passes end-to-end integration tests (auth, request/response shape, error handling) in CI
Performance: P95 latency for chat/completions (<= 220ms) at target payload distribution (short: 0-128 tokens) during canary (baseline cluster load)
Throughput: embeddings batch throughput within 10% of dedicated-embedding baseline for equivalent gpu class
Reliability: automated canary must show error rate < 0.3% and graceful fallback occurs on model unavailability
Observability: every microbundle request surfaces model_variant, region, kernel_version in Console logs and traces
Billing: usage for microbundle SKU appears correctly in invoices and Console cost breakdown and matches test billing events
SDK compatibility: official JS and Python SDKs provide idiomatic wrappers and examples that pass smoke tests
Security: secret scoping and request-level audit logs validated by Security (security_review_required = true)
Docs: PRD-linked open-source migration guide and three cookbooks (chat migration, embeddings bulk upload, rerank integration) published
Rollout gating: canary metrics (p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens) must remain within agreed thresholds for 48 hours before regional expansion
launch_checklist: PRs merged: runtime, API gateway, SDKs, Console telemetry, pricing UI
End-to-end tests green in main branch and release candidate tag created
Load tests executed and results stored (link to load-test dashboard in follow-up comment)
Security review completed and sign-off attached to release ticket
Docs published: API reference, migration guide, pricing FAQ, examples repo updates
Billing mapping verified with Finance and internal test invoice generated
Canary plan scheduled with monitoring runbook and on-call rotations notified
Migration notice drafted for customers who previously used separate endpoint SKUs
SDK versions bumped and packages published to npm/pypi with compatibility notes
Console: cost/latency breakdown panels added and tested with synthetic traffic
Rollback plan documented and smoke rollback steps validated on staging
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Internal canary (team-only) for 48 hours -> Stage 2: Controlled customer canary (5% traffic, opt-in) monitoring p95/error/cost for 7 days -> Stage 3: Regional enablement by EU/US/APAC with 24–72 hour observation windows -> Stage 4: GA with full marketing and pricing change. Each stage requires sign-off from PM, Runtime Eng lead, and Observability owner before progressing.
metrics: Adoption: number of unique tenants calling microbundle endpoints by week
Performance: P50/P95/P99 latency per endpoint and per model_variant
Cost: average cost per 1k tokens and per 1k embeddings
Business: revenue from microbundle SKU and conversion rate from free to paid
risks_mitigations: Risk: users rely on subtle differences between legacy endpoints and microbundle -> Mitigation: detailed migration docs, shim compatibility layer in SDKs
Risk: canary uncovers model degradation -> Mitigation: automatic fallback to last-known-good model and rollback triggers in routing layer
Risk: billing misattribution -> Mitigation: Finance smoke tests, synthetic billing events, pre-GA audit
Risk: observability gaps for new telemetry fields -> Mitigation: require Console dashboards and alerting before canary
Risk: high costs for embeddings due to batching mismatches -> Mitigation: conservative default batch size, adaptive batching knobs exposed in Console
dependencies: ENG-92710: gateway routing adaptive model selector
SEC-1012: security assessment for new telemetry fields
